information: ## Welcome to the Malaysia Cube Championship 2022! ![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg) For more information, you may visit us at [Malaysia Cube Championship 2022 Website](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/mcc2022) or follow us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/mycubeassociation/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/mycubeassociation/) **Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.** **Please note** Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition *Participants representing Malaysia will win special medals, prizes and the title of Malaysia Champion.
